key_insight: Random splits reward memorisation of duplicated perovskite device recipes, while provenance-grouped evaluation reveals which models generalise beyond familiar data.
engineering_relevance: Evaluating models on unseen institutions and future discoveries better tests their usefulness for guiding new solar-cell designs and fabrication choices.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Progressively isolate duplicate devices, publications and institutions using grouped splits.
Benchmark 13 models and analyse the importance of chemistry, architecture and fabrication features.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe with another; tree ensembles lead on random splits, but composition-aware neural models excel on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
watch_item: Reliable implementation requires accurate recipe matching and provenance metadata; the abstract provides no numerical performance margins.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
